plugin.name: Responsive Images
plugin.summary: Generates responsive image variants and modern image formats for PKP publications.
plugin.description: Generates responsive image variants for public-facing PKP content, including srcset/picture output, WebP and AVIF conversion when supported by the server, manifest-based caching, incremental optimization, and scheduled/background optimization support.

release.description: Initial Plugin Gallery release for OJS 3.5. Adds responsive image generation, WebP/AVIF support, caching, and background optimization.
